text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, whew, whew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso and I had returned to Funabashi 
Racecourse to prepare for the Diolite 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To bridge that 3.3-second gap... I have 
come this far.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time... on this home turf! 
*cough*, *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training driven purely by sheer obsession. 
...The exhaustion is severe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I... can no longer stop myself. The 
hammer with no tomorrow is about to strike 
down at any second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But—if only just once more.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list:
Are you really going to see this 
through?... Even if you have to be 
ruthless?

Are you really going to see this 
through?... Even if you have to be 
ruthless?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, I will do it. Right before 
everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one could stop the raging torrent 
toward retribution. A bloody resolution 
awaited. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heavens, at times— wash away 
everything, even the will of mankind.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer!? Is this...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mid-March. A massive earthquake disaster 
struck Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, not just Funabashi. The disaster area 
encompasses all of eastern Japan. It is 
truly an unprecedented—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Everyone!! Are you all okay!?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Furi-chan! Pull through somehow! Come 
on... please...!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Our... racetrack... is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a dreadful sight... Spanning from 
the third corner into the fourth, numerous 
fissures cracked across the track—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ground under the track and stands has 
liquefied... It's sunken in places, making 
it dangerous to even walk...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: How terrible... Our... Funabashi is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: At this rate... forget racing...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let me go look to see if anyone 
is injured...!
choice_data_list: No good, we need to evacuate first!
No, you need to evacuate first!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: However...!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: An emergency... state... Yes... indeed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I firmly held them back. Right now, 
ensuring everyone's physical safety was 
the top priority.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the next few days, the entire country 
fell into chaos. The Diolite Kinen, 
naturally, was cancelled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a time, the continuation of the 
Twinkle Series hung in the balance. 
However... the URA moved quickly.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, let us hear the Academy's 
opinion. We should manage to repair the 
racetrack somehow, but.”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a conundrum…… Should we race in this 
situation, or not?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like the Umamusume will be 
able to run with a calm mind either. What 
do you think, Student Council President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I believe we should do it. So long as we 
can run safely, and the safety of the fans 
is guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
How are things... on the Umamusume's side? 
Are her feelings alright?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is our duty to entertain and 
inspire people through our racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Inside or outside the racecourse, I intend 
to do everything within my power. All for 
the sake of—our recovery.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Morioka—! Put some soul into this track 
maintenance, you slackers!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell we're leavin' our memorable 
racetrack like this! Gimme those rubble 
bags, c'mon!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It seems... the time for me to take the 
stage has come. I haven't been in the mood 
lately, which led to a string of narrow 
defeats, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I—must show them.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All across the country, Umamusume continue 
their energetic activities.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Races in the Kanto region will also resume 
in April. Fans have erupted into massive 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Racing even in this 
situation...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even after suffering this many disasters, 
her resolve to run remains unshaken."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, that determination 
shines all the brighter. To entertain 
people, and to lift their spirits, I will 
give it everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What... conviction... Her mental readiness 
for the race is on a whole other level...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It was so overwhelming that, at times, it 
came across as arrogant, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
She's not shallow enough of an opponent to 
be overcome by mere frustration...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: This... immense pride...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's obsession... gradually 
dissipated. And then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio, how've you been...? I'm feeling a 
bit lost over here, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What is the matter, Tran-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso receives a message. It was from 
Transcend, who was in Dubai to run in an 
international GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm feeling a bit conflicted. When 
the whole country is going through so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I began to wonder if it was really okay 
for me to just stay overseas and keep 
racing like this.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I started thinking, maybe there's 
something else I really oughta be doing?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating and disappointing, 
but... I'm also considering scratching 
from the race..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even within the JRA, the atmosphere is a 
bit different between domestic and 
international circuits. The away team 
seems to be keeping a low profile, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Please run, Tran-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Furio?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, the Umamusume of the JRA are 
working together as one."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not by quitting racing, but rather by 
continuing to run, to bring cheer to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Central circuit. They 
truly are Umamusume worthy of respect. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tran-san, you are one of them as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm... one of them too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everyone has high hopes for you. For 
the three chosen arrows, and for your 
valiant efforts. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Races are never meaningless. There is 
meaning! A tremendously huge meaning, in 
fact.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"So please run. If you from the URA ever 
lose your way—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If you waver, those of us from the local 
circuits chasing after you will lose our 
way too. So please—believe in yourself."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Furio... Yeah, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's like my eyes have been opened. We're 
gonna show 'em what we've got!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, see you later then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furioso quietly ended the call. And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san isn't the only one... who woke 
up.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Me as well. I knew it... I have to accept 
it now."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Central is wonderful. And that is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I must face this with an unwavering spirit 
that won't be outdone either. As an 
athlete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as if answering Furioso's cheers.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Dubai International GⅠ! A one-two 
finish for Japan!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a miraculous one-two finish! Though 
falling just short, Transcend puts up a 
tremendous effort for 2nd place—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—A major catastrophe. With that as the 
turning point, the flow of everything was 
cut off all at once. And then—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It begins with this victory in Dubai. 
Every part of our revival."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we must make a change. In our 
approach toward races. And—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we can do it again. A big race... 
even at our Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The G1 Kashiwa Kinen scheduled for May at 
Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been officially cancelled yet. 
If it's still being held, that's where we 
go!
